description: Rename an email template without modifying its content (lightweight — no re-render triggered). Use after nevent_clone_template to give the clone a proper name, or to reorganize existing templates. Returns the updated template with the new name. Next step: nevent_update_template to change content, or nevent_preview_template to validate rendering.

name.description: The new name for the template. Must be between 1 and 255 characters. Duplicate names are allowed by the API.

template_id.description: The ID of the email template to rename. Use nevent_list_templates to get valid template IDs.

name: nevent_rename_template
